# Phase 1 results (generated by scripts/10_phase1.py)

## Method A: gradient-boosting counterfactual trained on clean non-promo weeks

- Non-promo rows: 375,564. Of these, **234,119 (62%)** are 'clean' (more than 4 weeks after the last promotion) and form the training set. Post-promo weeks are excluded because they carry the pantry-loading dip Phase 2 measures.

### Validation on a held-out 20% of clean non-promo weeks

| target   |   n_train |   n_holdout |   rmse_model |   mape_model |   rmse_naive_woy |   mape_naive_woy |   rmse_naive_sp |   mape_naive_sp |   calibration |
|:---------|----------:|------------:|-------------:|-------------:|-----------------:|-----------------:|----------------:|----------------:|--------------:|
| units    |    187295 |       46824 |        5.275 |        0.425 |            8.927 |            0.605 |           7.387 |           0.502 |         1.001 |
| hhs      |    187295 |       46824 |        4.369 |        0.402 |            7.357 |            0.572 |           6.027 |           0.475 |         1.001 |

- Units: model RMSE 5.27 vs naive store-product-week-of-year median 8.93 (+41%); MAPE 42.5% vs 60.5%. The model beats the naive benchmark.
- A second naive benchmark (store-product median, no seasonality) is shown as `*_naive_sp`.

- Aggregate calibration on the clean holdout: actual/predicted = **1.001** (1.0 = unbiased).
- Sanity check on **post-promo weeks (1-4 weeks after a promotion, never trained on)**: actual/predicted = **1.029**. Relative to the holdout calibration this is **1.029**. Below 1 means these weeks sell less than an undisturbed week (a pantry-loading dip); above 1 means, in aggregate, they do not. Phase 2 looks at this per event and per category.

## Method B: difference-in-differences against same-product control stores

- 49,384 promotion runs (events). 78% have at least 4 clean pre-weeks; **22% (10,798) have at least 3 valid control stores** (same product, not promoted during the run, at least 4 clean pre-weeks).
- Median number of controls when available: 28.
- Events without controls are mostly chain-wide feature/price events; this is a finding about the promotion mechanism, not a failure of the method. Method A covers them.

### Parallel trends

- Max absolute gap between treated and control indexed series over t-8..t-1: **0.013** (both are indexed to 1.0 by construction on average). Figure: outputs/figures/phase1_parallel_trends.png
|   rel_week |   treated |   control |   treated_se |   control_se |   n_events |
|-----------:|----------:|----------:|-------------:|-------------:|-----------:|
|     -8.000 |     1.016 |     1.005 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   7362.000 |
|     -7.000 |     0.990 |     0.993 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   7598.000 |
|     -6.000 |     0.998 |     0.985 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   7735.000 |
|     -5.000 |     1.003 |     1.011 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   7910.000 |
|     -4.000 |     0.998 |     1.003 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   7893.000 |
|     -3.000 |     0.992 |     0.999 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   8155.000 |
|     -2.000 |     0.990 |     0.996 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   8403.000 |
|     -1.000 |     1.011 |     1.017 |        0.004 |        0.002 |   9822.000 |

### Placebo test at t-3

- 26,952 placebo events. Mean placebo DiD = **-0.01 units/week** (95% CI -0.08 to 0.06); as a share of the counterfactual: **-0.1%**. Compare with the real per-week DiD effect of 7.77 units/week. The placebo is 0% of the real effect.
